descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-01 Patient Chart Card · S13 「从没录入的字段不会在卡片上编出来」 Fields that were never entered are not invented on the card

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 The card shows age/sex in the "76F" format.（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U5 The card shows the hospital day (Hospital) or the visit number (Nursing Home).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）
  • U1 Each patient renders as a card on the home screen showing the patient's first and last name and room (Nursing Home: unit/room).（UAT TC-01；TFA-92579 AC 3）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Standard fixture: the Hospital patient has age but no sex, MRN or admit date; the resident has no unit, age or DOB

When Snapshot the Hospital list, Nursing Home Today's Visits and All Residents

Then No placeholder junk and no guessed sex letter appears on either card

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: every list checkpoint mustContain 'Open chart for <name>' and mustNotContain 'undefined', 'NaNy', 'null' and the chart-only 'pre-round notes'; the Hospital list also mustNotContain '72F' / '72M' (no sex is stored, so a sex letter would be invented, 3.4 spirit). …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U22；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

UAT item: TC-01 Patient Chart Card · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-01/S13

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa)

Result: Pass from scripts/oracle.mjs on the saved evidence (units/U22.verdict.json), unit U22 split by its parts' checkpoints. Agent: 81 turns, 275 s, $0.62.

Plan: unit U22 (#22, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Lists and cards, both contexts. Same legacy seed, same list screens. All four only look, open a chart, or flip In Today and flip it back. S13 (nothing entered is invented) runs first, before anything is opened. EFS S12 runs second: it turns In Today off and on and its checkpoint 4 checks the restore, so the parts after it start from a checked state. TC-01 S02 runs last, because its final tap ('tap it once more so it is back as it was') has no checkpoint after it. Runs together with EFS/S12, TC-01/S01, TC-01/S02.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #22, U22; checked: yes): Fail (S02 only, product) — S02: NH card shows the diagnosis on Today's Visits and All Residents — same root cause as U01 (cluster C1: NH card diagnosis, TFA-92581 AC 3 / UAT TC-03 + TC-01). S13, EFS S12 (empty Today's Visits message + how to add), S01 pass
